name: YUCCA FILAMENTOSA
key_symptoms: Aches as if top of head would fly off. Arteries of forehead throb. Nose red.
guiding_symptoms: Aches as if top of head would fly off. Arteries of forehead throb. Nose red.
head_symptoms: Aches as if top of head would fly off. Arteries of forehead throb. Nose red.
gi_symptoms: Deep pain in right side over liver, going through back. Stool yellowish brown, with bile.
urinary_symptoms: Burning and swelling of the prepuce, with redness of meatus. Gonorrhśa (Cann; Tussil).

source.title: YUCCA FILAMENTOSA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
